chunks: Yunus narrated from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) used to grant the son of the brother, along with the grandfather, the inheritance of the father."
ai.seo_question: Does the paternal grandfather inherit alongside the nephew in Shia inheritance law?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the 'Hajb' (exclusion) dynamics in Shia inheritance law, specifically addressing the concurrence of the paternal grandfather and the nephew (son of the brother). It establishes that the grandfather does not exclude the nephew, nor vice versa, but rather they share the estate proportionally to the share the father would have received, a ruling that distinguishes Shia jurisprudence from some Sunni schools regarding the grandfather's status as a 'residuary' heir.
